market_question: Will the Republicans win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: The 2028 election is far off, with no candidate known, so the baseline probability for either party should be near 50%. The market implies a 38.5% chance, an 11.5-point discount with no clear structural justification. Historical party win rates are roughly even over the long term, and even potential incumbency effects from 2024 do not warrant such a low probability.
evidence_points: Historical Republican presidential win rate since 1968 is ~57%, close to 50% over all elections.
No candidate or major scenario is known that would systematically handicap the GOP 4 years out.
Incumbency effects, if any, are diluted by open-seat dynamics and shifting coalitions.
sources_consulted: current event context as of early 2025 (no 2024 winner known yet)
